name: Air Brake Test and Departure Inspection
description: A train is ready for departure from the terminal, requiring an inspection before movement. The Car Inspector performs a thorough check of the train's braking system while the Yardmaster oversees compliance with regulatory standards throughout. If any issues are found during inspection, repairs must be made immediately before the train can be cleared. Once the air brake test and inspection are complete, the train is handed over to the Switchman for departure from the yard. The process concludes when the train has successfully passed all required tests and inspections.
pain_points: Terminal dwell and trip-plan compliance as competing metrics

steps.name: Car Inspector performs air brake test using YardVision Analytics
steps.output: Test result, clearing 1,200 cars per week
